messages.subject: Single Night Sleep Analysis
parts:
Hello,

A colleague of mine just asked a question about how many days are necessary for a valid sleep analysis. The data set includes multiple 7 day windows, but they are just interested in accessing the summary data for one single night within each window (i.e., night 3 at time point 1 and night 3 at time point 2).

Do you happen to have any recommendations for best practices when analyzing a single night of sleep at a time using GGIR?

Thank you for your time and assistance!

Best Regards,

John

--
John D. Chase, MS
Doctoral Candidate
Kinesiology Department
University of Massachusetts Amherst

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: Single Night Sleep Analysis
parts:
Hi John,

They can process the 7 days as usual in GGIR and then look at the nightsummary reports from part 4 to extract the information from their night of interest. Would that work?

Best,
Jairo
